name: CAS President's International Fellowship Initiative (PIFI) – Visiting Scientists / Postdoctoral
duration: See website (past calls: 1-12 months for visiting scientists)
eligibility: Researchers worldwide nominated by a CAS host; visiting-scientist category usually expects established researchers
eligibility_note: PIFI is 'open to scientific research personnel from around the world', but the official site says it is being optimised and applications are TEMPORARILY SUSPENDED.
how_to_apply_tip: PIFI takes no direct applications: a CAS host must nominate you. Ask a CAS collaborator whether a 2027 batch is open at their institute.
deadline_quote: PIFI is currently undergoing optimization work, and applications for related projects are temporarily suspended. Please stay tuned for the new version of PIFI.
verdict_reason: The official PIFI portal says applications are temporarily suspended, so no current call text exists to check against the profile. The archived portal text names 'Visiting Scientists' as a category open to researchers worldwide.
eligibility_quote: It is open to scientific research personnel from around the globe, of the following seven types: Distinguished Scientists, Visiting Scientists, Postdoctoral Researchers ... PIFI does not accept direct applications from foreign scientific research staff. Foreign applicants must find a CAS scientist as his or her host researcher, who would recommend him or her for PIFI application.
ask_funder: When will the new version of PIFI open, and can an Associate Professor at a private transnational college in Pakistan, less than 2 years post-PhD, be nominated as a Visiting Scientist (or must they use the Postdoctoral category)?

name: COMSTECH Research Fellowship Programme (CCoE)
funder: OIC Ministerial Standing Committee on Scientific and Technological Cooperation (COMSTECH)
amount: International low-cost return airfare paid by COMSTECH; host institution expected to provide subsistence and supervision
eligibility: Young researchers with MS (age <= 35) or PhD (age <= 45) or active researchers; citizens of or employed in an OIC member state; preference to early-career researchers
eligibility_note: Open to citizens of all OIC member states (Pakistan is a member and COMSTECH host); placement at CCoE member institutions in OIC countries
how_to_apply_tip: Pick a CCoE host outside Pakistan from COMSTECH's list, then email the online form, CV, 2 references and head-of-institution letter to comstech@comstech.org.
deadline_quote: Deadline: Applications /Nominations are open all around the year
verdict_reason: You are a Pakistani (OIC) citizen with a PhD, and the post-PhD track caps age at 45, so ages 36-45 pass. The page sets no limit on years since PhD, so your January 2024 award does not matter, and it sets no institution-type limit. You must apply before you turn 46.
eligibility_quote: Age limit: Maximum 35 years (For graduate studies), 45 years (For post-graduate studies) ... Eligible Countries: All OIC member states. ... They are offered to young scientists holding at least an M.S or equivalent degree for graduate studies, and Ph.D. for post-graduate studies or involved in active research. Eligible applicants for the research fellowships are young scientists and Engineers who are citizens of an OIC country, or are employed by a research institution in an OIC country.

name: DFG Initiation of International Collaboration (guest visits)
amount: Travel + DFG standard maintenance allowance for guests (see DFG form 1.813)
duration: Guest visit up to 3 months, within 12 months of approval
eligibility: German-based researcher with PhD applies; guests from abroad are generally doctorate holders
eligibility_note: DFG page names no country restriction for guests; the German host applies on your behalf.
how_to_apply_tip: Ask a German collaborator to submit a short proposal for your guest visit; it is also usable for repeat visits to build a joint DFG project.
deadline_quote: Proposal Deadlines: Proposals may be submitted at any time.
verdict_reason: The German host is the applicant and must hold a doctorate and work in Germany. The page sets no nationality, institution, age or career-stage rule for the guest, so nothing excludes you as the visiting guest.
eligibility_quote: Eligibility Requirements: Researchers who have already achieved their doctorates and who are working in the German scientific system may apply. ... Funding is available for the following collaborative measures: Trips abroad (max. three months) or guest visits in Germany (max. three month); Exploratory workshops.

name: Erasmus+ International Credit Mobility – Staff Mobility (KA171)
amount: Travel + daily subsistence at Erasmus+ unit rates (see website)
eligibility: Academic/admin staff of a partner HEI with an inter-institutional agreement with a European university
eligibility_note: Programme Guide covers mobility with non-associated third countries (Asia region); the EC Pakistan Erasmus+ factsheet confirms Pakistani institutions take part in ICM.
how_to_apply_tip: Ask your university's international office which EU partners hold KA171 projects with Pakistan; teaching visits require at least 8 hours of teaching per week.
deadline_quote: 19 February at 12:00:00 (midday Brussels time) both for projects funded with internal policy funds starting on 1 June of the same year and for projects funded with external actions instruments starting on 1 August of the same year.
verdict_reason: Staff of HEIs in non-associated third countries such as Pakistan may take part. The sending HEI must be 'recognised by competent authorities' and hold an inter-institutional agreement, and it is unclear whether BIC, a private TNE college that is not HEC-chartered, counts. The 19 February deadline applies to the EU HEI; the 2027 call has not been published.
eligibility_quote: Staff working at a HEI in an EU Member State or third country associated to the Programme or third country not associated to the Programme. ... The sending organisation must be a HEI from an EU Member State or third country associated to the Programme awarded with an ECHE or a HEI from a not associated third country recognised by competent authorities that has signed inter-institutional agreements with their partners ... before the mobility takes place. In case of mobility involving third countries not associated to the Programme, the duration must be from 5 to 60 days, excluding travel time.
ask_funder: (To the EU partner HEI / its National Agency) Does Beaconhouse International College, a private TNE college delivering University of Essex and LJMU degrees but not itself HEC-chartered, qualify as a 'HEI recognised by competent authorities' for a KA171 inter-institutional agreement, or must mobility go through the UK degree-awarding partner?

name: CNRS–Imperial Global Researcher Short Visits in AI in Science
funder: Imperial College London I-X / CNRS–Imperial 'Abraham de Moivre' IRL (Schmidt AI in Science)
amount: GBP 950/week subsistence + up to GBP 1,500 return economy flights + standard visitor visa fee (GBP 127) + contribution towards travel/medical insurance (2026 terms)
eligibility: Researchers/faculty at universities or research centres in LDCs/LMICs (OECD list); need link to a CNRS-Imperial collaboration and an Imperial host
eligibility_note: Open to OECD-listed LDCs and LMICs (Pakistan is a lower-middle-income country on the OECD DAC list); country not named explicitly.
how_to_apply_tip: The scheme runs over 3 years with up to 4 visits a year; contact an I-X Imperial supervisor now so you are ready for the next call.
deadline_quote: Application deadline: 31 May 2026 ... Placements must take place in 2026. Separate calls will be launched to recruit applicants for 2027 and 2028 visits.
verdict_reason: Pakistan is an OECD-listed LMIC, but applicants must be researchers 'from universities or research centres', and BIC is a private TNE college. It is unclear whether that counts, and Pakistan is not named on the page.
eligibility_quote: Applicants must be researchers from universities or research centres in LDCs, or LMICs, or Brazil, Chile, or South Africa. Applicants must have links, or be keen to develop links, to one of the CNRS-Imperial collaborations ... The call is open to faculty members who are not current Schmidt AI in Science Fellows. Each applicant must secure a host supervisor
ask_funder: Would a faculty member of a private transnational college in Pakistan (delivering University of Essex/LJMU degrees, not a degree-awarding university) count as being 'from universities or research centres in LMICs' for the 2027 call, and when will the 2027 call open?

name: Research Stays for University Academics and Scientists
amount: Monthly research allowance + travel allowance (see website for current rates)
eligibility: University teachers / established academics, normally with a doctorate, employed at a university or research institute in their home country; host invitation from a German university or research institute
eligibility_note: Offered worldwide via the DAAD scholarship database with country-specific deadlines (DAAD Pakistan publishes them). Official DAAD pages returned HTTP 503 on verification day; details confirmed via DAAD-derived call texts (ECR Central, university notices). Re-check the Pakistan entry in the DAAD database.
how_to_apply_tip: Secure a written invitation/supervision confirmation from a German host first; search the DAAD database with 'Pakistan' as country of origin to get the exact deadline.
deadline_quote: This programme is not available right now. (German version of the same DAAD database entry: 'Dieses Programm wird aktuell nicht mehr angeboten.')
verdict_reason: DAAD's own short link for this programme (daad.de/en/stip2) resolves to a database entry that says the programme is no longer offered. DAAD Pakistan's postdoc programme list does not include it, so no call is open to you.
eligibility_quote: This programme is not available right now. / Dieses Programm wird aktuell nicht mehr angeboten.

name: Re-invitation Programme for Former Scholarship Holders
amount: EUR 2,000/month (assistant professors/lecturers) or EUR 2,150/month (professors) + travel allowance
eligibility: Only former DAAD research/study scholarship holders funded for at least 6 months, or EPOS graduates; working in academia in home country
eligibility_note: Open to DAAD alumni worldwide; country-specific deadlines. Conditional on being a former DAAD scholarship holder. Official DAAD page returned HTTP 503 on verification day; terms confirmed via Research in Germany listing.
how_to_apply_tip: Only relevant if you held a DAAD scholarship (e.g., for your PhD in Germany); line up the same or a new German host and apply via the DAAD portal.
deadline_quote: Application deadlines are updated annually in the second quarter. In most cases, they are in the same period as the previous year. You can find the current dates here: 31.08.2026 Selection date in February 2027 Start of funding in May 2027 at the earliest
verdict_reason: Only former DAAD research or study scholarship holders funded for more than six months by the Federal Foreign Office qualify. The profile does not record any DAAD scholarship; without one you are not eligible.
eligibility_quote: You can apply if you are former holder of DAAD research grants or study scholarships and have been funded for more than six months by the Federal Foreign Office or in a programme co-financed with Federal Foreign Office funds. ... You have not lived in Germany for at least three years. The research or working project must be coordinated with a cooperation partner in Germany.
ask_funder: (Self-check first) Did you hold a DAAD scholarship funded by the Federal Foreign Office for more than six months? If yes, ask DAAD Pakistan whether that scholarship qualifies and confirm the 2027 deadline once it is published in Q2 2027.

name: Punjab HEC International Postdoctoral Scholarship (IPDS)
eligibility: Regular (BPS/TTS) faculty of public-sector universities/colleges chartered by Government of Punjab; no postdoc in last 5 years
eligibility_note: Provincial scheme for Punjab public-sector faculty; official page behind a bot-check, latest dated call found was 2023 – confirm next round
how_to_apply_tip: Get leave/NOC from your parent institution and a host acceptance before the call; hard copies are sent by registered post.
verdict_reason: The official PHEC page (punjabhec.gov.pk) and its web-archive copy could not be opened; the site returned a 403 bot check. Search pointers (not evidence) say the scheme is for faculty of Punjab public-sector colleges and universities, which would exclude a private TNE college.
ask_funder: Is faculty of a private transnational college in Punjab (Beaconhouse International College) eligible for the PHEC International Postdoctoral Scholarship, or only regular faculty of public-sector institutions chartered by the Government of Punjab? When is the next call?

name: Royal Society International Exchanges (Global rounds)
amount: Up to GBP 3,000 (single visit ≤3 months); up to GBP 6,000 (1 yr) or GBP 12,000 (2 yrs) for multiple visits
duration: Single visit up to 3 months, or multiple visits over 1-2 years
eligibility: PhD or equivalent; UK-based scientist with contract applies jointly with overseas collaborator; natural sciences incl. computing; new collaborations only
eligibility_note: Royal Society: Global rounds accept collaborations with 'any country or territory outside the UK'.
how_to_apply_tip: The UK partner is the lead applicant; it must be a new collaboration (not a former supervisor/colleague). Both partners must be based in their countries when applying.
deadline_quote: 2026/R3 Opening Dates: Thursday, 30 July 2026; Closing Dates (15:00 UK time): Thursday, 24 September 2026; Expected result: March 2027
verdict_reason: The overseas co-applicant must hold a contract at an eligible organisation, which is defined as a university or not-for-profit research institution. Private organisations are listed as ineligible, and BIC is a private college. The scheme would only fit if you were based at a university or a not-for-profit institute.
eligibility_quote: The applicant and co-applicant must hold a permanent or fixed term contract for the duration of the award in an eligible organisation in their respective countries/territories. ... Eligible host organisations are a university or not-for-profit research institution. Ineligible organisations include industrial, private and commercial organisations, university spin-out companies, and governmental bodies.

name: Simons Institute Research Fellowships (Fall 2027: Diffusion Generative Modeling)
funder: Simons Institute for the Theory of Computing, UC Berkeley
amount: Competitive salary and benefits; visa and housing assistance
eligibility: Early-career researchers within about 5 years of PhD in theoretical CS / ML theory
eligibility_note: No nationality restriction stated on the official pages.
how_to_apply_tip: Apply to the semester program closest to your research (cover letter, CV and research statement in one PDF, plus 3 referees).
deadline_quote: The application period opens on October 1, 2026, and applications are due December 1, 2026.
verdict_reason: Your PhD was awarded in January 2024, so it will be about 3.6 years old at the start of the 2027-28 academic year, well within the five-year limit, and faculty may apply. The page sets no nationality, age or institution rule. How well you fit a theory-focused programme (Diffusion Generative Modeling) affects your chances, not your eligibility.
eligibility_quote: Simons Institute Research Fellowships are intended for exceptional young scientists (within at most five years post-PhD the start of the 2027–28 academic year). ... Applicants who already hold junior faculty or postdoctoral positions are welcome to apply. ... Salaries and benefits are competitive, and assistance with visas and housing will be provided.

name: CAS-ANSO Visiting Scientist Fellowship
funder: Alliance of International Science Organizations (ANSO) / Chinese Academy of Sciences
amount: RMB 15,000/month (assistant prof/postdoc level), RMB 25,000 (associate), RMB 35,000 (full prof) + one round-trip travel subsidy
eligibility: Scholars outside mainland China at assistant professor level (incl. postdocs) or above; must be formal employees of home institution; applied via a CAS host researcher
eligibility_note: Open to researchers from outside mainland China; ANSO members get priority (several Pakistani institutions are ANSO partners – check member list)
how_to_apply_tip: Contact a CAS institute host (e.g. Institute of Automation or Institute of Computing Technology) by early spring – the host submits on your behalf.
deadline_quote: The evaluation for 2025 will take place from May to June. Please note that applications submitted after April 24th will not be considered.
verdict_reason: Based on the latest (2025) call text, scholars at any scientific or educational institution outside mainland China at associate professor level qualify, so BIC counts. There is no age, nationality or years-since-PhD rule; you must not have had PIFI funding in 2023-2025. No 2026/2027 call is posted, so re-check the text when a new call appears.
eligibility_quote: Category II: ANSO Visiting Scientist Fellowship. Eligibility: Scholars from scientific and educational institutions outside Chinese mainland. They could be assistant professors (including postdocs), associate professors, professors, or professionals at a comparable level in related fields. ... Applicants who have received sponsorship through the CAS PIFI Program in 2023, 2024, or 2025 are not eligible for CAS-ANSO Fellowship funding.

name: TWAS-TÜBİTAK Postdoctoral Fellowship Programme
amount: TRY 43,500/month stipend (2024/1 call) + private health insurance (TÜBİTAK); travel and visa costs (TWAS)
eligibility: PhD holders, max age 45, natural and applied sciences; host at a Turkish university or TÜBİTAK centre
eligibility_note: TWAS: open to nationals of developing countries in the South; not one of the Pakistan-hosted programmes that exclude Pakistanis.
how_to_apply_tip: The latest published call is 2024/1 (closed 16 Dec 2024); no later call is posted. Get a preliminary acceptance letter signed by the Turkish host's rector or director before applying, and watch the TÜBİTAK 2216-B page.
deadline_quote: The call for applications is open until 16 December 2024. (TÜBİTAK 2216-B application dates: 2024/1 — 01 October 2024 to 16 December 2024)
verdict_reason: You are a Pakistani national employed in Pakistan with an EE PhD, and Engineering Sciences and Computing & IT are eligible fields. There is no years-since-PhD rule. You must be 45 or younger on 31 Dec of the application year, which fails if you are 45 when applying and turns 46 by then.
eligibility_quote: Be permanent residents and nationals of a developing country in the South ... Be employed in a developing country (other than the host country) and hold a research assignment there. ... Hold a PhD degree in natural and related applied sciences (in one of the fields specified above); Be a maximum age of 45 years on 31 December of the application year;

name: IPAM Long Program Participation – Artificial Intelligence in Materials Science (Fall 2027)
funder: Institute for Pure and Applied Mathematics (IPAM), UCLA (NSF)
amount: Financial support (housing and travel) for extended participation; amount not stated
eligibility: Researchers at all career stages; early-career participants encouraged
eligibility_note: No nationality restriction stated on the IPAM page.
how_to_apply_tip: Watch the program page and apply as soon as the form opens; stress your ML for scientific modeling work.
deadline_quote: Applications will be accepted through Friday, April 16, 2027, but offers may be made at any time, up to one year before the start date. Applications received after the deadline will still be considered if there is space available.
verdict_reason: Funding is open to researchers at all career levels in this area. The page has no nationality, age or institution restriction, and your AI/ML background fits the program theme.
eligibility_quote: We typically offer support to recent PhDs, graduate students, and researchers in the early stages of their career; however, mathematicians and scientists at all levels who are interested in this area are encouraged to apply for funding.
